name: Micaiah
summary: A prophet, the son of Imlah, whom Israel's king hated, saying he only ever foretold trouble for him. When four hundred prophets promised victory at Ramoth-gilead, Micaiah alone spoke the LORD's warning.

key_moments.title: Vows to Speak Only the LORD's Word
key_moments.description: The king's prophets all said to go up to Ramoth-gilead and win. When Micaiah was sent for, he was told to agree with them, but he promised to speak only what the LORD told him.

key_moments.title: Warns Ahab He Will Fall
key_moments.description: Micaiah saw Israel scattered over the hills like sheep with no shepherd. He told of seeing the LORD on His throne, and said a lying spirit was speaking through the king's prophets.

key_moments.title: Struck and Sent to Prison
key_moments.description: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah slapped Micaiah's face, and the king had him jailed on scant bread and water. Micaiah answered that if the king ever came home safely, the LORD had not spoken through him.
